notes:
A new engine and a completely rebuilt interface.

## New engine
- SteamLite now runs on Tauri 2 (Rust and the system web view) instead of Electron. The installer is about 27 MB instead of about 103 MB, and the app itself is a few megabytes.
- Everything behind the interface (your library, settings, Steam and Discord connections, play tracking, hotkeys, tray, updates) is the same proven backend as before. Your settings and data carry over unchanged.

## New interface
- Rebuilt from scratch with GPU-friendly animation: springs on every press and hover, pages that scroll up and down as you move between them, a floating dock, and a soft glow that takes the colour of the game you are looking at.
- Home, Library (smooth even with thousands of games, grid or list, collections, A to Z jump), game pages (stats, achievements, news, screenshots, notes, launch options), Friends, Profile, Themes, Settings and a search you can open anywhere with Ctrl+K.
- Profile customisation: banner, tagline, title, avatar frame, accent colour, game showcase and pinned achievements.
- All existing themes work.
- A short introduction opens after you first sign in, and can be replayed from Settings.
- The old interface has been removed. Messages, drops, shop, trophy room, events, wishlist and sales, inventory, notifications and the tools hub are not part of this beta yet and will return in the new design.

## Updating
- Works with the SteamLite Updater: the release installer is named SteamLite.Setup.<version>.exe, installs over an existing SteamLite in the same folder (replacing the old program files, keeping your settings) and understands the updater's /S, /AllUsers and /CurrentUser switches.

## Beta notes
- Beta builds do not hand out XP, levels or SteamLite achievements, so testers cannot lose or corrupt progress.
